  "analysis": "The training data reveals that German legal texts contain specific, recurring organization names (courts, tax offices, ministries) often preceded by articles like 'das', 'des', 'dem' or verbs like 'hat', 'ist'.       "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 10,
      "reasoning": "High precision rule for major courts. The context anchors (articles/prepositions) ensure we don't match generic nouns like 'Bescheid' or 'Rechtsprechung' which are also capitalized."
    },
    {
      "name": "Tax Offices",

        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"

      "output_key": "entities",

      "reasoning": "Captures tax offices which are frequent entities. The pattern handles the genitive case 'Finanzamtes' and the abbreviation 'FA' followed by location names."

    {

      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 8,
      "reasoning": "Specific pattern for Vienna municipal authorities which appear frequently in the training data with varying levels of detail (with/without department number)."

    {

        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 7,
      "reasoning": "Captures social security organizations. The context anchor ensures we don't match other capitalized nouns."
    },
    {
      "name": "Companies with Legal Form",
      "description": "Matches company names ending in GmbH, AG, KG, etc., preceded by 'der', 'des', 'dem' or 'der'.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:der|des|dem)\\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*\\s+(?:GmbH|AG|KG|OHG|UG))",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "organisation"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 6,
      "reasoning": "Generalizes company detection using legal form suffixes. Using a capture group ($1) ensures we extract only the company name without the preceding article."
    },
    {
      "name": "Ministers/Departments",
      "description": "Matches Bundesminister variations.",

      "pattern": "(?:des)\\s+Bundesministers(?:in)?\\s+für\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+(?:,\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*",

        "text": "$0",

      },
